scope: Full codebase vocabulary sweep across all 11 canonical surfaces (post-Phase-9)

inconsistencies.title: CLI Role Vocabulary Extends Beyond DACC-v1 Hierarchy
inconsistencies.details: AGENT_ROLE_TRAITS in cli.ts:3400-3407 defines 7 roles (director, orchestrator, broker, worker, participant, coordinator, bridge). DACC-v1 hierarchy (ROLE_DEFINITIONS.md:6-23) defines only 5. Broker's isWorkerAgent() only recognizes 5 canonical roles.
inconsistencies.impact: Agents registered with coordinator/bridge daccRole have no authority mapping; treated as generic workers.
inconsistencies.remediation: Either add coordinator/bridge to DACC-v1 with authority definitions, or remove from CLI traits.

inconsistencies.title: AGENT_STATUS_LEDGER Missing 5 of 6 Phase-8 Seeded Agents
inconsistencies.details: Phase 8 added STANDING-BY rows for 6 seeded agents. Only opencode-cli-agent appears in ledger (line 298). Missing: kilo-cli, pi-coding-agent, claude-code, tnf-hermes, jules.
inconsistencies.impact: Human-visible standing-by record incomplete; operators cannot see full seeded fleet.
inconsistencies.remediation: Append 5 missing STANDING-BY entries with canonicalEntityId, registration timestamp, status.

inconsistencies.title: ROLE_DEFINITIONS.md Defines canonicalEntityId Incorrectly
inconsistencies.details: Line 40: 'canonicalEntityId: Registry row identifier (integer PK)'. Actual format is hierarchical string TNF:[scope:]CATEGORY:PROVIDER:NAME:INSTANCE.
inconsistencies.impact: Developers confuse hierarchical federated ID with internal DB primary key.
inconsistencies.remediation: Correct line 40 to describe hierarchical TNF identity format with example.

inconsistencies.title: ROLE_DEFINITIONS.md Missing idNumber Band Allocation Section
inconsistencies.details: seed-agent-registry.ts:54-58 documents band allocation table referencing 'See ROLE_DEFINITIONS.md'. ROLE_DEFINITIONS.md has no such section. Also missing vector_id disambiguation.
inconsistencies.impact: Single source of truth for ID bands is seeder code, not canonical definitions doc. 2026-08-09 collision fix not reflected in docs.
inconsistencies.remediation: Add 'Provisional edge IDs → idNumber band allocation' section with three-band table and vector_id note.

inconsistencies.title: FEDERATED_BASE58_ALPHABET Duplicated Across 5 Files
inconsistencies.details: Canonical Base58 alphabet defined identically in 5 files: a2a-core (canonical), TranscriptProcessorV2, seed-agent-registry, federation-identity.ts, federation-protocol.cjs. No single import; drift risk.
inconsistencies.impact: If alphabet changes, 5 files must update in lock-step. Current comments acknowledge but no enforcement.
inconsistencies.remediation: Export from a2a-core as single source; update 4 consumers to import; add CI check.

inconsistencies.title: qualities Deprecated Alias Still Used in Registry Stats
inconsistencies.details: agent-registry.service.ts:337 uses a.qualities for getStats().withQualities. DB column renamed to traits in migration 0009. In-memory Agent keeps qualities as deprecated back-compat.
inconsistencies.impact: Stats may be inaccurate if qualities not populated on in-memory agents.
inconsistencies.remediation: Update getStats() to check canonical traits field with fallback to qualities, or remove qualities entirely.

inconsistencies.title: vector_id Namespace Not Documented in ROLE_DEFINITIONS.md
inconsistencies.details: Phase 9 FOLLOWUP-1: vector_id (ID#:Base58(hash[:8])) shares ID#: prefix with idNumber but encodes hash bytes. KNOWLEDGE_TREE.json uses vector_id. ROLE_DEFINITIONS.md has no mention.
inconsistencies.impact: Consumers seeing ID#: cannot distinguish sequential idNumber from hash-derived vector_id.
inconsistencies.remediation: Add vector_id disambiguation to ROLE_DEFINITIONS.md Federated ID section. Consider migrating to VEC#: prefix.

relay-core in-memory registry: daccRole, workerAction, traits, federation
